# Boise Tree Pros

> Boise Tree Pros is a tree care company serving Boise and the Treasure Valley in Idaho. ISA-certified arborists handling tree removal, tree trimming and pruning, stump grinding, and 24/7 emergency storm response for residential and commercial properties across Boise, Meridian, Nampa, Caldwell, Eagle, and Garden City. $2M insured on every job. Phone: (509) 351-8404.

## Services

- Tree removal. Most removals in Boise cost $500 to $5,000. Small trees under 25 feet run $300-$800; large trees over 50 feet typically $2,000-$4,000+; very large or hazardous trees 80+ feet or in complex positions $4,000-$8,000+. Stump grinding as an add-on is $150-$500.
- Tree trimming and pruning. Most trimming costs $150 to $2,000. A small ornamental under 25 feet runs $150-$400, mid-size 25-50 feet $350-$900, large 50-80+ feet $800-$2,000+. Specialty work needing a crane or near power lines starts around $1,500.
- Stump grinding. $75 to $400 per residential stump. Small stumps under 12 inches $75-$150; large stumps 24 inches and up $250-$600+.
- Emergency and storm tree service, 24/7. Branch removal from a structure $150-$850; large trees on structures $1,500-$4,000+; full range $150-$7,000+ depending on size, what it landed on, and complexity. Most Idaho homeowner policies cover $500-$1,000 per tree for removal, up to $5,000 per storm event.
- Tree health assessment, cabling and bracing, and hazard evaluation by ISA-certified arborists.

All figures above are ranges, not quotes. Estimates are free and on-site.

## Service Area

Boise Tree Pros serves the Treasure Valley in Ada and Canyon County, Idaho. Each community below has a dedicated local service page.

- [Tree Service in Meridian, ID](https://boisetreepro.com/tree-service-meridian/): ISA-certified tree removal, trimming, and stump grinding for Meridian homeowners.
- [Tree Service in Nampa, ID](https://boisetreepro.com/tree-service-nampa/): Tree care across Nampa and Canyon County, including removals and storm damage.
- [Tree Service in Caldwell, ID](https://boisetreepro.com/tree-service-caldwell/): Tree removal, trimming, and stump grinding for Caldwell properties.
- [Tree Service in Eagle, ID](https://boisetreepro.com/tree-service-eagle/): Arborist services for Eagle's mature landscape and foothills properties.
- [Tree Service in Garden City, ID](https://boisetreepro.com/tree-service-garden-city/): Tree care for Garden City lots and Boise River corridor properties.
